Bumps `version` in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to 2.3.0. It adds a new feature and breaks nothing, so this is a minor release.

This PR also rewrites the [release steps](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/chore/release-2.3.0/CONTRIBUTING.md#releases) and adds `.github/workflows/release.yml`, which creates the draft release and moves `v2` when a version tag is pushed.

## Release notes

### Added
- **Working-tree continuity** (#33, added in #44). A thread now keeps the files that pi leaves uncommitted, staged and unstaged, on `refs/pi/worktrees/<number>`, and restores them at the start of the next run. When you rewind or fork the conversation, the files rewind too. Two new inputs: `worktree_snapshots` (default `true`) and `worktree_snapshot_exclude`. See [Working-tree continuity](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#working-tree-continuity).

## After merging

Per [Releases](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#releases):

```bash
git switch main && git pull
git tag -a v2.3.0 -m v2.3.0
git push origin v2.3.0
```

Then review the draft release that `release.yml` creates, and publish it.

`npm run check` passes on this branch.
EOF
